info.title: logaffe
info.description: The read and write surface of one logaffe installation. Every installation is at its own address.

get.summary: Whether this installation has an operator, and whether it can be claimed.

post.summary: Gives this installation an operator, and signs them in.
Draws a second factor and a sheet of backup codes, and stores neither.
Starts a session for the operator.
Ends the session this request was made with.
Takes a batch of log entries for the project its token names.

delete.summary: Ends every session but this one.

put.summary: Takes a new password, and ends every other session.

post.summary: Replaces the backup codes with a fresh set, shown once.
Draws a second factor and a sheet of backup codes, and stores neither.

put.summary: Replaces the second factor, issues fresh backup codes, and ends every other session.

post.summary: Brings a project into existence, which is the only way one comes about.

get.summary: One project, which is what its settings are reached by.

patch.summary: Gives a project another name; the identity is not one.

delete.summary: Ends a project, immediately and irreversibly.

get.summary: How many entries a retention window would remove, before it is applied.

put.summary: Changes how long a project keeps its entries.

get.summary: One page of a project's entries, newest first by event time.
What has arrived since the last poll, in the view's order.
How many entries a filter set matches, optionally grouped.
One entry in full, with its exception and its properties.

post.summary: Gives a project a token to receive on.

get.summary: What one project can currently receive on.
The token that is in the row, and the delivery to paste it in.

post.summary: Gives an agent a token to read with.

get.summary: Every agent token the installation holds.

patch.summary: Gives an agent token another label.

get.summary: The token that is in the row, and the configuration to paste it in.
